action.objective: Consolidate the queen on g3, defending the g4 pawn push and keeping pressure on e5 and d3.
action.rationale: h3g3 is the only commit-ready move: depth-2 verification gave exact score -59 with no mating reply, no forced mate, and tactical_refutation not_found. It avoids moving into a knight fork, defends g2/g4, and keeps d5 knight tension. Broad search ranked it top; h3h4 was an upper bound. No nodes remain for alternative verification, so committing the verified choice.
